translations.Las respuestas se guardan en este navega: Answers are saved in this browser.
translations.Un ordenador, tres niveles de comprensió: One computer, three levels of understanding
translations.Reconoce sus piezas, explica cómo trabaj: Recognise its parts, explain how they work and apply those ideas to information and memory problems.
translations.Responde las 21 preguntas en orden. En l: Answer all 21 questions in order. Include your working and units in calculations. Check each block before finishing.
translations.Las respuestas abiertas se entregan al p: Open answers are submitted for teacher review. Completing a block is not a grade. Hints are inside the workbook: you do not need to open other pages.
translations.1. Enumera las cuatro unidades funcional: 1. List the four functional units of a computer.
translations.Separa la entrada y la salida como dos u: Count input and output as separate units.
translations.2. Enumera los tres componentes principa: 2. List the three main components of the CPU.
translations.Piensa en quién coordina, quién opera y: Think about coordination, operations and temporary values.
translations.3. Enumera los tres tipos de buses de un: 3. List the three types of computer buses.
translations.Distingue qué se transmite: valores, ubi: Distinguish values, locations and coordination signals.
translations.4. Enumera los cuatro tipos principales: 4. List the four main peripheral categories and give one example of each.
translations.Utiliza la clasificación del tema: entra: Use the unit categories: input, output, communications and storage.
translations.5. ¿Cuántos bytes ocupa el texto Hola co: 5. How many bytes does the text Hola occupy in UTF-8?
translations.Cuenta solo los bytes del texto, sin ter: Count only the text bytes, without a terminator, BOM or program metadata. ASCII characters occupy one byte in UTF-8.
translations.6. Ordena de menor a mayor: petabyte, gi: 6. Order from smallest to largest: petabyte, gigabyte, byte, megabyte, terabyte and bit.
translations.Escribe una secuencia separada por <. Lo: Write a sequence separated by <. This question uses decimal prefixes.
translations.7. Ordena registros, caché L2, caché L3,: 7. Order registers, L2 cache, L3 cache, RAM and L1 cache by increasing access latency. Where would you place ROM?
translations.Usa un ordenador convencional. Para la R: Assume a conventional computer. For ROM, explain why its technology and interface are needed before assigning a fixed position.
translations.8. Define con tus propias palabras: orde: 8. Define in your own words: computer.
translations.Explica qué es y para qué sirve en una o: Explain what it is and what it is used for in one or two sentences. Expanding an acronym is not enough.
9. Define in your own words: ALU.
translations.10. Define con tus propias palabras: uni: 10. Define in your own words: control unit.
translations.11. Define con tus propias palabras: bus: 11. Define in your own words: bus.
translations.12. Define con tus propias palabras: RAM: 12. Define in your own words: RAM.
translations.13. Define con tus propias palabras: CPU: 13. Define in your own words: CPU.
translations.14. Define con tus propias palabras: arq: 14. Define in your own words: Von Neumann architecture.
translations.15. Define con tus propias palabras: mem: 15. Define in your own words: cache memory.
translations.16. Define con tus propias palabras: con: 16. Define in your own words: controller.
translations.17. Codifica Hola en UTF-8 y expresa sus: 17. Encode Hola in UTF-8 and express its bytes in hexadecimal.
translations.Escribe un par hexadecimal por byte, sep: Write one hexadecimal pair per byte, separated by spaces. You may use these Unicode code points: H = U+0048, o = U+006F, l = U+006C, a = U+0061.
translations.18. ¿Qué es UTF-16 y en qué se diferenci: 18. What is UTF-16 and how does it differ from UTF-8?
translations.Referencia: UTF-16 representa cada valor: Reference: UTF-16 represents each Unicode scalar value with one or two 16-bit units; UTF-8 uses one to four bytes. Explain why characters do not all take the same space.
translations.19. ¿Cuánto tarda en transmitirse Hola C: 19. How long does Hola Caracola take to transmit over a 56 bit/s link?
translations.Usa UTF-8, incluye el espacio y excluye: Use UTF-8, include the space and exclude quotation marks. Assume a constant rate and no overhead. Show characters → bytes → bits → seconds and round to three decimal places. This is a hypothetical 56 bit/s link, not 56 kbit/s.
translations.20. ¿Para qué se utiliza el registro PC: 20. What is the PC register used for during program execution?
translations.Explica qué información conserva y qué o: Explain what information it holds and what happens when a jump is executed.
translations.21. ¿Cuántos bytes se pueden direccionar: 21. How many bytes can be addressed with 16-bit addresses?
translations.Cada dirección identifica un byte. Escri: Each address identifies one byte. Show the number of possible addresses and the capacity in bytes and KiB. Processor word size alone does not determine the address width.
